appearances.whereabouts: traveling with his father from their Westwood farm to Emond's Field via the Quarry Road, then arriving at the village Green and Winespring Inn
appearances.notable_actions: walks alongside the cart with bow and nocked arrow, watching for wolves and bears; sees the mysterious Black Rider and is paralyzed by the sensation of being hated; stumbles when breaking eye contact with the rider; discusses the rider with Mat; helps unload cider barrels at the inn
appearances.demeanor: alert and wary at first, then frightened and unsettled after seeing the Black Rider; relieved to reach the village; tries to convince himself the rider was imagination but doesn't believe it; apprehensive about seeing Egwene

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Rand from their Westwood farm to Emond's Field, delivering brandy and cider to the Winespring Inn
appearances.notable_actions: walks steadily with his spear as a staff, guiding Bela; discusses the harsh winter and wolf problems with villagers; delivers brandy to Bran al'Vere; offers to look for hoofprints when Rand reports the rider; teaches Rand about the flame and the void; engages in debate with Bran and Cenn about village matters
appearances.demeanor: solid, impassive, matter-of-fact; a pillar of calm and reality; skeptical but not dismissive of Rand's concerns; good-humored with the Mayor

appearances.demeanor: patient, steady, familiar with the route
